items.question: What is BabaBuilds ERP?
items.answer: BabaBuilds ERP is an all-in-one financial management platform for agencies and freelancers. It delivers multi-currency invoicing, tax-ready GST/VAT compliance workflows, AI-powered bank reconciliation, retainer tracking, and real-time dashboards.

items.question: Does BabaBuilds ERP support GST and VAT compliance?
items.answer: Yes. BabaBuilds ERP supports GST/VAT workflows with country-aware setup defaults, configurable tax rates, and zero-rated export invoicing. Advanced compliance packs are available for select markets, while additional jurisdictions are supported through core country-aware setup and are being expanded.

items.question: Can I use BabaBuilds ERP for multi-currency invoicing?
items.answer: Absolutely. BabaBuilds ERP supports invoicing in any currency — USD, INR, OMR, EUR, and more — with automatic formatting and live exchange rate awareness.

items.question: Is BabaBuilds ERP free to use?
items.answer: BabaBuilds ERP offers a free tier with full product access and limits on clients, invoices, and shop listings. Pro and Team add payment gateways, higher seat limits, and more document storage.

items.question: Which payment gateways does BabaBuilds ERP integrate with?
items.answer: BabaBuilds ERP integrates with Razorpay (for INR payments) and Stripe (for international payments), enabling you to embed payment links directly into your invoices.
